section_3.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM

section_4.title: Application: The Probabilistic Prediction Engine
section_4.content: Conclude by demonstrating how an LLM acts as an 'autocomplete' machine on steroids. It predicts the probability of the next token based on all previous tokens.
section_4.example: A robot librarian suggesting the next word in a sentence: Given 'The', it suggests 'cat' (high probability) or 'car' (lower probability) based on the context of the preceding paragraph.

        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject
